description: Resolve a profile URL or vanity name to a SteamID64. Turns any of the accepted identifier forms into a 17-digit SteamID64. Does not fetch the profile. Turn a steamcommunity.com/id/... or /profiles/... link, or a custom URL name, into the SteamID64 the inventory and player tools need.

q.description: A steamcommunity.com profile URL, a custom URL name, or a SteamID64.

name: resolve_steam_profile
title: Resolve a profile URL or vanity name to a SteamID64
